name: Converter
short: Convert fuel economy and everyday measurements.
description: Convert fuel economy, distance, speed, weight, volume, temperature, area, and time with common unit aliases.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Use `[p]convert 15 km/L to mpg` or `[p]convert units` to get started. MPG defaults to US; use mpg-UK for imperial MPG.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store end user data or send conversion requests to external services.
